scope: Execution specification for the already-preregistered Phase-1 primary and held-out paper-claim gates. This artifact does not change any threshold, candidate, seed, exclusion set, or controller behavior.
input_validation: Require baseline and candidate record keys to match exactly within each training seed.
Require exactly 7248 unfiltered records and all six expected benchmarks for every method and training seed.
Require id, problem text, gold answer, and samples_per_problem to match within each baseline/candidate pair.
Require record keys and the same invariants to match exactly across training seeds.
Require the exclusion-source SHA-256 to match before reading the 30 fixed problem keys.
Require the exclusion set to contain exactly 30 unique problem keys: 16 AMC23 and 14 MATH500.
After exclusion, require exactly 6680 records, 872 problems, and all six benchmarks for every method and held-out seed.
Reject missing, duplicate, extra, non-boolean-castable correctness, changed snapshot, changed sample count, or changed exclusion data.

metric_definition.sample_delta: float(candidate.correct) - float(baseline.correct) for each exactly matched record
metric_definition.problem_delta: Arithmetic mean of sample_delta within one (benchmark, problem_index).
metric_definition.benchmark_delta: Arithmetic mean of problem_delta across retained problems in one benchmark.
metric_definition.seed_macro_delta: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the six benchmark_delta values.
metric_definition.heldout_mean_macro_delta: Unweighted arithmetic mean of seed_macro_delta for seeds 43 and 44.
metric_definition.heldout_mean_benchmark_delta: Unweighted arithmetic mean of one benchmark_delta across seeds 43 and 44.
metric_definition.filtering: Remove every record whose (benchmark, problem_index) belongs to the frozen conservative_union before recomputing all problem, benchmark, and macro deltas.

heldout_gate_checks.individual_seed_macro_delta_strictly_gt_: Both seed-43 and seed-44 macro deltas must be > 0.0; equality fails.
heldout_gate_checks.mean_macro_delta_at_least_0.005: The arithmetic mean of the two seed macro deltas must be >= 0.005; equality passes.
heldout_gate_checks.at_least_four_positive_benchmark_means: At least four of six two-seed mean benchmark deltas must be > 0.0; equality to zero is not positive.
heldout_gate_checks.worst_benchmark_mean_at_least_minus_0.02: The minimum two-seed mean benchmark delta must be >= -0.02; equality passes.

primary_gate.implementation: Use scripts/analysis/aggregate_multiseed_full_bench.py without changing its six preregistered checks.

combined_claim_decision.stable_cross_seed_generalization: primary gate passes AND heldout unfiltered gate passes AND heldout filtered gate passes
combined_claim_decision.phase1_pass_without_stable_claim: primary gate passes AND either heldout gate fails
combined_claim_decision.phase1_failure: primary gate fails regardless of either heldout result

required_output_provenance: SHA-256 of every input records file
SHA-256 of preregistration and exclusion source
all Boolean checks and the combined claim decision
record/problem counts before and after filtering
required_tests_before_acceptance: Passing synthetic unfiltered and filtered gates.
Failure when either held-out seed delta equals zero.
Pass/fail boundaries at mean macro delta 0.005 and worst benchmark -0.02.
Failure with only three positive benchmark means or a fourth mean equal to zero.
Failure for an altered exclusion-source hash, duplicate exclusion key, wrong exclusion count, or wrong benchmark distribution.
Failure for mismatched record keys or snapshot invariants within or across seeds.
Failure for any filtered record/problem count other than 6680/872.
Combined claim-policy tests for all primary/unfiltered/filtered pass-fail combinations.
implementation_timing: Do not modify analysis code while the provenance-locked Phase-1 controller is active. Implement and test this exact specification only after the controller terminates, then evaluate the immutable records.
researcher_degrees_of_freedom: No threshold, inequality direction, averaging unit, seed, benchmark, exclusion key, expected count, or claim-policy branch may be changed after observing held-out evaluation results.
